title: Hidden mines grid game with flags
when: The user wants the classic grid of hidden mines: reveal cells, numbers count nearby mines, flag suspects, clear every safe cell to win.
prompt:
Goal: A fair board (first click is always safe), instant flood reveal and full keyboard and touch play.
Steps:
1. Levels 9x9 with 10 mines, 16x16 with 40, 30x16 with 99; place mines after the first click, keeping that cell and its neighbors safe.
2. logic.mjs: createBoard(w, h, mines, safeIndex, rand), neighbors(i), counts, reveal(board, i) with an iterative queue flood fill for zeros, toggleFlag, chord when flags equal the number, status.
3. Grid of buttons with roving tabindex: arrows move, Enter reveals, F flags; right click and a 500 ms long press flag.
4. aria-label per cell: "Row 3, column 4, hidden", "flagged", "2 mines nearby"; numbers in text plus color.
5. Header: mines left, timer, New game; result in aria-live; on loss show all mines and wrong flags.
6. Best time per level in localStorage guarded.
7. test.mjs: first click safe, counts, flood stops at numbers, win detection.
Quality bar:
- Large board scrolls inside its frame.
- No context menu on flagging.
- Timer starts on the first reveal.
Pitfalls:
- Recursive flood fill overflowing the stack.
- Mines placed before the first click.
- Revealing a flagged cell.
Verify:
- [ ] Cells labeled.
- [ ] Status live.
- [ ] Logic tested.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (board), test.mjs.

examples.output: Beginner/Intermediate/Expert, safe first click, flags by right click or long press
